outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of breast anatomy and breast cancer classification with approximate frequencies; it presents no replicated experimental data requiring replicate reporting.
Panel B is a conceptual schematic illustrating the study aim; it contains no experimental data or replicates.
Panel C is an illustrative schematic of the luciferase recording method; it is not a presentation of actual replicated experimental measurements.
Panel D is a schematic showing example (illustrative) traces for the analysis workflow, not real replicated data requiring n reporting.
Panel E shows an illustrative example heatmap representing the correlation analysis concept, not actual experimental replicate data.
Panel F is a schematic illustrating the growth quantification approach with example model curves, not real replicated data.
Panel G is a schematic illustrating the drug sensitivity characterization approach with example dose-response curves, not real replicated data.
Panel H is a schematic illustrating the genomic analysis workflow using example heatmaps, not actual replicated experimental data.

Panel I is a schematic illustrating the concept of defining circadian-based cellular subtypes via PCA and parameter clustering; it depicts example/illustrative data points, not reported experimental replicates.
